# HRBaires

> HRBaires is a boutique recruiting and staffing partner for high-growth startups across LatAm, NA and EMEA, specialized in fintech, SaaS and Web3/crypto. Founded by Pablo Sojo, based in Buenos Aires, Argentina.

HRBaires works directly with founders and executives on two core services:

- **Recruiting**: full-cycle search — defining the role, compensation and org structure before sourcing starts, for high-growth startups in fintech, SaaS and Web3.
- **Staffing / Staff Augmentation**: embedded recruiting for companies hiring across LatAm — engineers, growth and ops roles, plus RPO and HR/admin backoffice — without building a local HR function from scratch.

Executive Search, Hiring Advisory and RPO are offered as extensions of these two services when the need calls for it.

Track record: average fill time of 1–2 weeks, high 12-month+ retention, and a replacement guarantee on every search. Experience includes scaling teams at Vostu (25 → 850 employees), Playtika/House of Fun (5 → 60 in Argentina within a ~400-person global team), The Sandbox (0 → 550+ employees across 6 countries in under 18 months), and Bondex (Seed → TGE, June 2025, USD 10M+ raised). Current and past clients include Sauce, Cedalio, Dive, Grupo Hasar, Composable Finance, Gurpi, Skipit, Boomerang, Caldera, Southteams and Hakuna.
